text:
nina.k: Hey payroll — my takehome for the 3/31 payrun is way off. Net went down by ~$950. Looks like federal tax was withheld twice and 401(k) still deducted even though I changed to 0% deferral on 3/10. Also I think both CA and WA state taxes show on the stub. Can someone look?

sam.payroll: Sorry to hear that, Nina. Can you drop a screenshot of the paystub (redact SSN) and confirm the pay period + last 4 SSN? Also did you submit the deferral change through Workday or the benefits form?

nina.k: Screenshot attached (sent privately). Pay period 3/16-3/31. Last4 4321. I updated deferral in Workday on 3/10 and got the confirmation email. I moved to WA full-time remote on 3/20 — submitted location change ticket to People Ops then.

payroll-bot: Case #PR-2026-495: Payroll exception received for nina.k. Notified sam.payroll and rachel.peopleops. ETA initial review 1 business day. :receipt:

rachel.peopleops: Tagging @sam.payroll — note that location change ticket LCT-987 was approved 3/22 (hr portal). Possible race where payroll ran with CA allocation for the early portion then didn't prorate state correctly.

sam.payroll: Thanks — initial notes: 1) Double federal withholding looks like duplicate tax calculation entry in pay engine (rare). 2) 401(k) deferral applied because deferral change effective date might have been set to next pay period instead of 3/10. 3) State: system did CA->WA split by days but WA tax should be 0; appears a residual CA withholding line stayed.

jorge-hr: Nina — sorry about the hassle. We will prioritize the correction. Payroll ops, if the vendor can’t hotfix this run, we should process an off-cycle reimbursement for net difference and then push a corrective adjustment in next regular run so W-2/quarterly reporting stays clean. Agree?

sam.payroll: Agreed. Next steps: (a) Payroll team to validate pay engine entries and confirm duplicate federal calc source. (b) If vendor can’t hotpatch today, issue off-cycle net reimbursement today (estimate $950) and create adjustment item for gross/tax corrections for the next run. (c) Re-evaluate 401(k) effective date and reverse contribution with plan admin if needed. (d) Confirm state withholding update to WA only.

nina.k: Thanks — would appreciate the off-cycle. Also can you confirm whether I need a corrected paystub for my records or a W-2c later?

sam.payroll: You'll get an interim corrected paystub with the off-cycle. If gross/tax lines change for the quarter we will issue a W-2c if necessary after reconciliation. We'll keep you posted in this thread.

rachel.peopleops: I'll follow up with Benefits/Workday team to check why the deferral effective date didn't apply. Sam, please escalate to vendor support if duplicate calc is from their side.

payroll-bot: Update: PR-2026-495 status -> In progress (vendor ticket VND-214 opened). Off-cycle reimbursement queued for same-day ACH pending approval.

sam.payroll: Update 18:02 — vendor confirmed duplicate federal tax entry from a job that retried tax calc on reprocess. They've fixed the rule and backfilled a corrective adjustment item. Off-cycle ACH approved; you should see the net reimbursement by EOD tomorrow. We'll post the corrected stub here when complete.

nina.k: Awesome, thank you all for the quick turnaround :relieved: Appreciate the clarity on W-2c possibility.

sam.payroll: Closing loop once stub and ACH confirmed. If you notice anything else, ping here or DM.
